area.comingSoon: Ɛreba. Saa beae yi yɛ bere tiaa bi de.

wellbeing.loginNeeded: Hyɛn mu na wakora check-in no.
wellbeing.roughHelp: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.suggestFilters: Nsonsona a wɔahyɛ ama wo ɛnnɛ
wellbeing.locksHelp: Wobɛtumi de adeyɛ bi ato mu dapɛn, nnawɔtwe mmienu, ɔsram baako anaa daa. Botɔn a ɛyɛ hu, mmoa a wɔasan aba, afonfrɔ a ahobammɔ wɔ mu ne data pepa ho nni mu da.

community.anonymous: Fa to gua a wonnim wo
community.noPhone: Wɔnnyi telefon nɔma ntoto nkrasɛm a ɛda yɛn ntam da.

support.resourcesNote: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.

safety.relapseDraft: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.safeContactsHelp: Fa wo sponsor anaa wo adamfo a ɔwɔ ahobammɔ mu no bɛn wo.
safety.vaultHelp: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.wipeHelp: Eyi pepa wo data no ampa, ɛnsan mma.
safety.wipeConfirm: Mete ase sɛ eyi bɛpepa me data no ampa.

reentry.tipsTitle: Afotuo a efi wɔn a wɔayɛ
reentry.tipsAnonymous: Afotuo no nni din. Wɔnnyi telefon nɔma ntoto da.
reentry.tipPlaceholder: Ɛdeɛn na ɛboaa wo wɔ saa anammɔn yi mu?
reentry.celebrationFirst: Anammɔn a edi kan awie — akwaaba wo fie.
reentry.celebrationAll: Anammɔn 33 awie. Di wo nkɔso no agorɔ.
reentry.crisisStep: Kora saa nɔma yi seesei. Wobɛtumi nso apia "Need help now" wɔ sreen biara atifi.
reentry.resourceOnly: Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nneɛma ho nko — Groundwork mfa eyi mma na ɛne obiara nni ayɔnkofa.

steps.step3: Firi aseɛ wo state ID ho nhyehyɛe
steps.step4: Fa botaeɛ to wo case manager ho
steps.step5: Yɛ wo fie sanebra ho nhyehyɛe
steps.step6: Siesie adamfo baako a ɔbɛboa wo
steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Hwɛ wo gyae ho nwoma ne daa a etwa to
steps.step10: Si check-in a edi kan da ne mmara no so dua
steps.step13: Fa telefon, email ne intanɛt a wonnya kwa
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step15: Kasa wo mpɔtam sanebramu nnwuma ho
steps.step16: Hunu mmara a wɔde hwɛ wo so
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step18: Hwɛ wo drovii ho tumi krataa tebea
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step24: Nya nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa nnubɔnenom ho
steps.step27: Kyerew kɔma wɔn a wɔma kwan a ɛtɔ so mmienu adwumawura
steps.step29: Bue sikakorabea akawont na yɛ sika ho nhyehyɛe
steps.step30: Firi aseɛ san si wo ka no
steps.step31: San kɔ wo ebusua ho, na siesie mma ho ka
steps.step33: Fa botae a ɛware kyɛ fa di wo nna 90 agorɔ

work.jobsTitle: Adwuma a ɛma kwan a ɛtɔ so mmienu
work.paroleNote: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.

journey.portfolioPrivate: Ɛyɛ kokoamfi firi mfiaseɛ. Kyɛ no nko sɛ wopɛ.

venue.placeholder: Beae a ɛyɛ bere tiaa — dan a ɛte sɛ adaka. Wɔmfaa mfonini a ɛyɛ nokware mmae; eyi nyɛ beae a ɛyɛ nokware.

family.help: Wʼebusuafo hu nea wopɛ sɛ wokyekyɛ nko.
family.defaultsOff: Wɔato nkyekyɛmu biara mu fi mfiaseɛ.

readAloud.title: Dede nkenkan
readAloud.help: Dede nkenkan no de wo mfiri no nne kenkan nwoma no.

phase3.resumeHelp: Yɛ resume a ɛyɛ mmerɛw fi wo nimdeɛ mu.
phase3.headline: Asɛnti
phase3.interviewHelp: Sua mmuae. Wo ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo no ma wo nkontabuo ne afotuo baako.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.geoHelp: Afoforɔ hu wo kurom nko. Wɔnkyekyɛ beae a ɛyɛ nokware da.
phase3.rideHelp: Bisa kar. Wɔnnyi telefon nɔma ntoto da. Hyia wɔ beae a obiara wɔ.
phase3.partnersTitle: Nnamfo a wɔbua wɔn ho akontaa
phase3.partnersHelp: Nkuokuo nketewa a wɔyɛ baasa baasa a wɔhwɛ wɔn ho.
phase3.caption: Mfonini ho asɛm
phase3.qaTitle: Nsɛmmisa ne mmuae a wonnim obi
phase3.qaHelp: Bisa a wonnim wo. Wɔn a wɔadi kan no bua.
phase3.merchHelp: Nsɔano a kɔde wɔ mu nko. Biribiara nni han a ɛkyerɛ ne nteaseɛ, wɔantintim nna.
phase3.shareHelp: Kaad baako a wo nkɔso ho nɔma wɔ mu.
phase3.archiveTitle: Daa a edi kan ho nkoraboa
phase3.archiveHelp: Sɔw nkrasɛm ma wo ho. Ebue da a ɛho hia no.
phase3.matchHelp: Wo anamusini no ne anamusifo afoforɔ kasa kan. Wɔato dɔ no mu seesei. Wobɛtumi ahu nea enti, abisa nnam ne asan asɔ ahwɛ.
phase3.datingOff: Wɔato dɔ no mu kosi sɛ wɔbɛyɛ mmara a ɛfa nna a wɔahyɛ ato hɔ ho.
phase3.carpoolTitle: Kar a wɔbom tenase so dua
phase3.carpoolHelp: Hwɛ ha kan. Wopɛ a, kurom nko: hwɛ hwan na ɔrekɔ wo nhyiam no na fa app no so nkrasɛm ne no nni nkitaho. Telefon nni hɔ, beae a ɛyɛ nokware nni hɔ.
phase3.carpoolJoin: Fa me ka dua no ho
phase3.groupsHelp: Akuo a ɛfa ahoɔden, sanebramu mmoa, gyidi ne ɔman ho a egyina kurom ne nhyiam bere so. Nhwɛso data nko — ɛnyɛ din a ɛyɛ nokware.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Wɔda no adi nko sɛ obiara nni dua no so a ɔrekɔ wo nhyiam no. Ɛfa abisadeɛ a wɔhwɛ so wɔ app no so to gua — kurom nko, telefon nni ho.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Kar a wɔbom nni hɔ mma saa nhyiam yi, enti wɔada Hia kar adi sɛ boa.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Wɔn a wɔapene wɔn so nko. Wɔfa nkrasɛm baako baako mena simma 2 twɛn mu; wosi so dua ansa na wɔakɔ nea edi hɔ.
phase3.approveContact: Hyɛ no nso sɛ kar gyinani a wɔapene so
phase3.pingStart: Fa kar gyinani a edi kan kɔ
phase3.pingConfirm: Si so dua ansa na wɔakɔ nea edi hɔ
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.musicHelp: Nhwɛso nnwom nko. Streaming akawont nni hɔ. Wɔayi nnwomtofo no afi adesua no mu.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Wɔayi nnwom no berɛ a wowɔ adesua no mu.
phase3.shareWho: Seesei: wo nko. Link yɛ ma obiara a ɔwɔ link no tumi kenkan.
phase3.suggestTitle: Nea wɔahyɛ afi wo nneɛma a ɛho hia ho
phase3.suggestHelp: Nhyɛ nyansa nko — wɔntintim hwee kosi sɛ wode bɛka ho.

crisisReply.onlyYou: Wo nko na wobɛtumi ahu saa nkrasɛm yi.
crisisReply.openCrisis: Bue botɔn a ɛyɛ hu ne afonfrɔ a ahobammɔ wɔ mu
